name: matrimony-microservices-root
description: Root runner for Matrimony Microservices Application

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend-service && npm install && cd ../user-service && npm install && cd ../match-service && npm install && cd ../connection-service && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:user" "npm run start:match" "npm run start:connection"
